notes.title: FREE DEMO IS OUT NOW! 🎮🚨
notes.content:
[h1]FREE DEMO OF DINNER DEFENDERS IS AVAILABLE NOW! 🍽💥[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961561/b69100daa9b72bb2408fcbd7ed29a5d20516bf4f.jpg[/img]
After the long process, finally we can give you our [b]first demo[/b] for Dinner Defenders! 🍗 Ready to defend your dinner from the most outrageous enemies? Grab your apron- I mean units, sharpen your skills, and dive into this chaotic tower defense adventure! 🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961561/168185fed42ad4ed05cdb51afc3d0a398fb8b715.gif[/img]
[h2]Enough speech, try it now![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3147280/Dinner_Defenders_Demo/?curator_clanid=44943224
💬 Let us know your first impression in the comments and don’t forget to wishlist the full game! 👀🛒
